prospects.thesis: SMCI is the leading provider of AI-optimized server and rack-scale liquid-cooled infrastructure, riding the hyperscaler and enterprise GPU buildout with a rock-bottom 0.6x P/S multiple. The +27.2% one-month move signals renewed confidence following prior accounting overhangs, and bullish options plus institutional flow suggest smart money is re-engaging ahead of accelerating Blackwell shipments. Valuation leaves ample re-rating room versus AI infrastructure peers.

MongoDB's document database and Atlas cloud platform are becoming a preferred backend for generative AI applications requiring vector search and unstructured data handling. The +26% monthly rally with bullish options and institutional accumulation suggests positioning ahead of the next earnings print, where Atlas consumption growth is the key catalyst. Enterprise AI workload adoption is inflecting, and MDB is a pure-play beneficiary.

Leidos is a prime beneficiary of accelerating DoD and intelligence community spending on digital modernization, cyber, and AI-enabled mission systems, with a large backlog providing revenue visibility. At just 1.0x P/S with +16.9% one-month momentum, it offers a rare combination of value and growth within defense IT services. Bullish options and institutional flow support continued upside as FY26 budget clarity emerges.

Kratos is the leading pure-play in unmanned aerial systems (Valkyrie, tactical drones), hypersonics targets, and satellite communications — all Pentagon priority areas under the Replicator initiative. Unlike LDOS (services), KTOS is a hardware/platform bet on autonomous warfare, offering differentiated exposure. Bullish options and institutional buying suggest positioning ahead of expected CCA (Collaborative Combat Aircraft) contract announcements.

UiPath's pivot from traditional RPA to agentic AI automation is gaining traction, with +39.2% monthly performance reflecting renewed enterprise interest in its Autopilot and AI agent offerings. The 5.0x P/S is reasonable for a re-accelerating SaaS name with bullish smart money signals. However, the sharp run-up warrants patience for a better entry given execution risk on the AI agent transition.

The bullish Healthcare flow is interesting because it's happening while drug pricing rhetoric is loud in Washington, suggesting smart money thinks the worst-case legislative outcomes are already priced in and Medicare/Medicaid budget fights won't be as bad as feared.
